faqs.question: Does either provider include daily automated backups at no extra cost?
faqs.answer: Neither provider includes daily automated backups on entry shared plans at no charge. InterServer includes weekly backups by default. Bluehost includes weekly backups on standard plans and daily backups on eCommerce plans. Bluehost’s CodeGuard advanced backup add-on costs $2.99/month for more granular control. faqs.question: Can I migrate my site to either provider without downtime?
faqs.answer: Both providers offer free site migration. InterServer handles the migration for you through their team.
